base_contact_A.note: One-sided proximity test; no chemical lower bound imposed. Does not validate proton transfer or protein-protein clashes.

mechanism_criteria.logic: Seven independent checks must pass within the one declared protein site, one substrate and same Zn. Asp10/Asp52 carboxylate oxygen names may be exchanged; retain both distances and select the nearest oxygen of the specified residue. Never replace His54/His71 with another residue.

threshold_basis.base_contact_A: 1IM5 Cys133 SG to Asp10 OD2 is 3.217/3.464 A in alternate conformers. 4.0 A is an author upper tolerance, not a proton-transfer rate boundary.
threshold_basis.reaction_distance_A: Legacy sulfur-attack operational window. No same-enzyme reactant-state quantitative validation is claimed.
threshold_basis.attack_angle_deg: Carbonyl nucleophilic trajectory is literature supported; 90-120 degrees is the legacy author operational window, not a validated activity boundary for 1IM5. Near-boundary failures must retain continuous angle.
threshold_basis.Zn_contact_A: 1IM5 protein donor distances 1.966/2.096/2.176 A; homolog mutant 3O94 substrate-ring N distances 2.257-2.314 A. Existing strict-quality Zn-N 106 contacts from 42 pairs and Zn-O 140 contacts from 41 pairs support the scale, not a universal window. 1.8-2.6 A is an author tolerance (105/106 N and 129/140 O contacts covered).
